title.zh: 空间可分离滤波与计算量

after.zh: 能拆成一列乘一行的核，才能先横后竖地串起来；拉普拉斯不是乘积，而是横竖两个二阶差分的和。
after.en: Only a kernel that is a column times a row runs as a pass across then a pass down; the Laplacian is no product but the sum of two second differences, across and down.

brief.zh: 拉普拉斯核 0 1 0 ／ 1 −4 1 ／ 0 1 0 写不成一列乘一行。只用一维三点核，能不能算出它？让输出和它一样。
brief.en: The Laplacian 0 1 0 / 1 −4 1 / 0 1 0 is no column times a row. Can 1D three-point kernels alone compute it? Make the output match it.
